# agyn_attachment (Resource)

Manages an Agyn attachment (a typed relationship between two entities).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_attachment" "example" {
  kind      = "tool_agent"
  source_id = agyn_tool.example.id
  target_id = agyn_agent.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Attachment kind specifying the relation type.
- `source_id` (String) Source entity ID (UUID).
- `target_id` (String) Target entity ID (UUID).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the attachment.
- `source_type` (String) Source entity type as reported by the API.
- `target_type` (String) Target entity type as reported by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_attachment.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
